label: Mood
description: The emotional temperature — each item names the mood and paints how it shows in the frame.

items.name: serene
items.text: a serene, unhurried calm, every element settled and balanced, nothing asking for attention

items.name: melancholic
items.text: a melancholic wistfulness, muted tones and empty space carrying a gentle ache of things passing

items.name: nostalgic
items.text: warm nostalgia, edges slightly softened and colors faded like a memory that improved with age

items.name: tense
items.text: taut suspense, held breath in the composition, something about to happen just outside the frame

items.name: ominous
items.text: ominous foreboding, weight gathering in the shadows and a low visual hum of dread

items.name: euphoric
items.text: euphoric weightless energy, light flaring, everything bright and lifted mid-celebration

items.name: triumphant
items.text: triumphant monumental grandeur, low angles and swelling scale, a chest-out heroic finale

items.name: intimate
items.text: hushed intimacy, close framing and soft light, a private moment the viewer almost intrudes on

items.name: playful
items.text: light-hearted playful charm, bouncing color and a wink hidden somewhere in the scene

items.name: mysterious
items.text: withholding mystery, more implied than shown, key details dissolving into shadow and haze

items.name: desolate
items.text: desolate abandonment, vast emptiness pressing in on one small element that remains

items.name: dreamlike
items.text: dreamlike reverie, physics gently loosened, glow where there should be edges
